test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: All bricks are spoons. No brick is a cricket.

Conclusion (I): Some crickets are spoons.

Conclusion (II): All spoons are crickets.
solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50a289d8d0bbafd1b0e8209a7dfe9619401a5cc25b85a4ac1ec9df95511745be.png] 

Conclusion (I): Some crickets are spoons. - False (There is no direct relation between cricket and spoons may be it is possible but not definite)

Conclusion (II): All spoons are crickets.- False (There is no direct relation between cricket and spoons may be it is possible but not definite)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3 "**
